summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.81/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.81 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 7, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 7¢ lower than a week ago, 34¢ higher than a month ago, and 98¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.61) and the highest in Superior ($4.03).
